source: Canonical curated registry of bridge-issued / trusted-mint token contracts on Berachain mainnet, derived from the 2025 zero-address mint baseline (personal artifact, gitignored) and public canonical-contract knowledge (explorers / official token lists); chain domicile and the 2026-08-27 ownership-amendment context come from the crypto-origin corpus (docs/maintenance/tax/crypto-origin/sources.md), which does NOT enumerate token contracts. Public contract addresses only; maintained committed (plan 2026-08-26 bridge-asset registry gate).

0x0555e30da8f98308edb960aa94c0db47230d2b.note: WBTC (Wrapped BTC, 8 decimals) - bridged Bitcoin on Berachain mainnet. Derivation evidence: identified from the 2025 zero-address mint baseline (personal artifact, gitignored) - three zero-address WBTC mints classified as bridge deposits during the bridge-mint classification work. Canonical-contract source (review r3 F2): berascan.com/token/0x0555e30da8f98308edb960aa94c0db47230d2b9c (explorer fetch blocked by HTTP 403, 2026-08-29); re-verified instead by on-chain eth_call symbol()/decimals() via the Berachain mainnet public RPC rpc.berachain.com (chainId 0x138de/80094), returning WBTC/8 (checked 2026-08-29). Chain provenance: crypto-origin corpus (docs/maintenance/tax/crypto-origin/sources.md) establishes Berachain's domicile, not this contract list.

0x69696969696969696969696969696969696969.note: WBERA - the canonical wrapped-native contract on Berachain mainnet (public explorer knowledge), observed extensively in the 2025 baseline (personal artifact, gitignored); a zero-address WBERA issuance is a trusted wrap of the holder's own BERA, never an airdrop. Canonical-contract source (review r3 F2): docs.berachain.com/build/getting-started/deployed-contracts lists WBERA at this address; re-verified by on-chain eth_call symbol()/decimals() via rpc.berachain.com, returning WBERA/18 (checked 2026-08-29). Chain provenance: crypto-origin corpus (docs/maintenance/tax/crypto-origin/sources.md) establishes Berachain's domicile, not this contract list.
